ReShade add-on API headers
==========================

Files: extern/reshade/*.hpp, unchanged copies of the include/ folder of
ReShade 6.8.0 (https://github.com/crosire/reshade).

Every header carries the line

    SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause OR MIT

so the headers may be used under either licence. Both texts follow: first the
BSD-3-Clause text of the ReShade repository (LICENSE.md), then the MIT text
for the copyright notice the headers carry.
